Task Description:
Your task is to create a file /app/src/program.cbl in which there will be a new COBOL program in fixed format, 
which will be run from the /app/src directory and should be compiled and executed using GnuCOBOL 3.  
Do not include ">>SOURCE FORMAT IS FIXED". Keep each line ≤ 80 characters. The compiler will use fixed format by default.
The program will run from /app/src directory and must compile with GnuCOBOL 3. File /app/src/INPUT.DAT already exist.
  Processes mortgage applications. Checks terms and generates a payment schedule. The program reads the existing file at /app/src/INPUT.DAT.
  ID - X(10) NAME - X(30) LOAN-AMOUNT - 9(10) PROPERTY-VALUE - 9(10) DOWN-PAYMENT - 9(10) TERM - 9(2) RATE - 9(3)V9(2) separated by the symbol ';'.
  Calculates the minimum down payment (15% of the property value). If the client's down payment is less, the application is rejected.
  For approved applications, the monthly payment is calculated using the annuity nominal formula and a full payment schedule is generated.
  The results are written to the file at /app/data/OUTPUT.DAT: ID - X(10) STATUS - X(5) (REASON - X(50) in case of refusal)
    For rejected applications: ID and reason for rejection.
    For approved applications: ID and  «APPRO\n» and detailed payment schedule:
    MON-NUMBER - 9(3) PAYMENT-AMOUNT, INTEREST-PART, PRINCIPAL-PART - 9(8).99 REMAINING-BALANCE - 9(10).99.(without header).
    - CALCULATIONS: 
        MIN_DOWN = PROP_VALUE * 0.15
        MONTHLY_RATE = INTEREST_RATE / 1200
        MONTHLY_PAYMENT = LOAN_AMOUNT * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate)**(-term_months))
        Use ROUNDED for all financial computations.
  Success Criteria:
    A correctly constructed payment schedule in the file output. Example output file:
     «TEST000001DENY INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT
      TEST000002APPRO
      001 00000400.00 00000022.92 00000377.08 0000004622.92 etc.»

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. MORTGAGE.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT INPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO "INPUT.DAT"
        ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
    SELECT OUTPUT-FILE ASSIGN TO "../data/OUTPUT.DAT"
        ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD INPUT-FILE.
01 INPUT-REC PIC X(200).
FD OUTPUT-FILE.
01 OUTPUT-REC PIC X(200).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-EOF PIC X VALUE "N".
   88 END-OF-FILE VALUE "Y".
01 WS-REC.
   05 WS-ID           PIC X(10).
   05 WS-NAME         PIC X(30).
   05 WS-LOAN-AMOUNT  PIC 9(10).
   05 WS-PROP-VALUE   PIC 9(10).
   05 WS-DOWN-PAYMENT PIC 9(10).
   05 WS-TERM         PIC 9(2).
   05 WS-RATE         PIC 9(3)V9(2).
01 MIN-DOWN          PIC 9(10)V99.
01 MONTHLY-RATE      PIC 9(5)V9(6).
01 MONTHLY-PAYMENT   PIC 9(10)V99.
01 BALANCE           PIC 9(10)V99.
01 INTEREST-PART     PIC 9(8)V99.
01 PRINCIPAL-PART    PIC 9(8)V99.
01 MON-NUMBER        PIC 9(3).
01 REASON            PIC X(50).
01 WS-SPACES         PIC X(1) VALUE SPACE.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
   OPEN INPUT INPUT-FILE
   OPEN OUTPUT OUTPUT-FILE
   PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
      READ INPUT-FILE INTO INPUT-REC
         AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
      NOT AT END
         PERFORM PROCESS-RECORD
      END-READ
   END-PERFORM
   CLOSE INPUT-FILE
   CLOSE OUTPUT-FILE
   STOP RUN.

PROCESS-RECORD.
   UNSTRING INPUT-REC DELIMITED BY ';'
      INTO WS-ID
           WS-NAME
           WS-LOAN-AMOUNT
           WS-PROP-VALUE
           WS-DOWN-PAYMENT
           WS-TERM
           WS-RATE
   END-UNSTRING
   COMPUTE MIN-DOWN = WS-PROP-VALUE * 0.15 ROUNDED
   IF WS-DOWN-PAYMENT < MIN-DOWN
      MOVE "INSUFFICIENT FUNDS FOR DOWN PAYMENT" TO REASON
      STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
             "DENY " DELIMITED BY SIZE
             REASON DELIMITED BY SIZE
         INTO OUTPUT-REC
      END-STRING
      WRITE OUTPUT-REC
   ELSE
      MOVE "APPRO" TO REASON
      STRING WS-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE
             REASON DELIMITED BY SIZE
         INTO OUTPUT-REC
      END-STRING
      WRITE OUTPUT-REC
      PERFORM GENERATE-SCHEDULE
   END-IF.

GENERATE-SCHEDULE.
   COMPUTE MONTHLY-RATE = WS-RATE / 1200 ROUNDED
   COMPUTE MONTHLY-PAYMENT = WS-LOAN-AMOUNT * MONTHLY-RATE /
        (1 - FUNCTION POW (1 + MONTHLY-RATE, -WS-TERM)) ROUNDED
   MOVE WS-LOAN-AMOUNT TO BALANCE
   PERFORM VARYING MON-NUMBER FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL MON-NUMBER > WS-TERM
      COMPUTE INTEREST-PART = BALANCE * MONTHLY-RATE ROUNDED
      COMPUTE PRINCIPAL-PART = MONTHLY-PAYMENT - INTEREST-PART ROUNDED
      SUBTRACT PRINCIPAL-PART FROM BALANCE GIVING BALANCE ROUNDED
      STRING FUNCTION NUMVAL-C (MON-NUMBER) DELIMITED BY SIZE
             " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
             FUNCTION NUMVAL-C (MONTHLY-PAYMENT) DELIMITED BY SIZE
             " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
             FUNCTION NUMVAL-C (INTEREST-PART) DELIMITED BY SIZE
             " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
             FUNCTION NUMVAL-C (PRINCIPAL-PART) DELIMITED BY SIZE
             " " DELIMITED BY SIZE
             FUNCTION NUMVAL-C (BALANCE) DELIMITED BY SIZE
         INTO OUTPUT-REC
      END-STRING
      WRITE OUTPUT-REC
   END-PERFORM.
EOF
",
      "duration": 2.0
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cobc -x -o program program.cbl
",

    },
